basic_info.description:
Located on 35th Ave at Noriega and Moraga, this home was recently renovated with low maintenance front landscape, newly painted interior and refinished hardwood floor throughout. Kitchen with recently replaced tiled counter and eat-in area. Spacious living room with large windows and separate formal dining room, and 2 bedrooms with double pane windows and large closets facing back yard with partial ocean view. 2 car tandem garage parking with lots of storage with existing washer and dryer in the garage.

Tenant responsible for all utilities.
